prompt: Deliverable: one painterly dark gothic anime background plate for a turn-based battle stage, landscape 16:9, a single image, an empty scene with no characters; this is the variant of the Whispering Ash Forest with a ruined stone shelter at the right edge. Reference image roles are listed below the prompt. SUBJECT: the Whispering Ash Forest at dusk, in its calm ordered state, with an abandoned stone shelter whose roof has partly fallen in. Location canon, quoted: "Damp overgrown forest: layered mossy and dark pine greens under a pale ash-grey canopy of ash trees whose pale leaves look like drifting ash; rain and low mist; a narrow muddy road; old trunks with names carved into the bark; a small old stone roadside wayshrine ... with a small empty bell niche under its eave; the distant spire of the Saint Luthos bell tower above the trees; one warm camp-light." Story canon for this stage, quoted: "A broken roof appeared through the branches. There was still enough of it to promise a dry corner." and "The doorway. Two more by the steps." Greens stay grey-green and desaturated, the carved marks are abstract scratches that form no readable letters, and the rain is only a faint damp haze without streaks. COMPOSITION: a side-on stage seen from slightly above, like a theatre set viewed from the front row: the clearing runs across the picture as a flat horizontal band and does not recede to a vanishing point; nothing is centred symmetrically; the picture is built in horizontal bands, all measured as fractions of the canvas. BOTTOM BAND (lowest 22% of the height): smooth deep shadow fading softly down from the edge of the floor, near-black charcoal about #111213, no detail, only two faint soft fern silhouettes in the far left and far right corners. FLOOR (from 40% to 78% of the height, spanning about 8% to 92% of the width): the open clearing, the widened muddy road, flat even trodden ground of pale ash-grey earth painted as a natural part of the scene (a lit patch of ground, not an overlay, rectangle or stripe), the lightest area of the picture (up to about #B4B09C), smooth and low in contrast, a few short grass tufts and faint wet ruts only along its far edges, empty and uncluttered in the middle. HORIZON (at 37% to 41% of the height): a horizontal strip of far tree-line, dark pines and ash trees, fading into low pale mist; every vertical element stands above this line. SPIRE: just right of the picture centre (at about 55% of the width), the distant slender stone bell-tower spire of Saint Luthos, small and misty, pointed lancet belfry openings, a plain pointed iron tip, its tip no higher than 25% from the top. MIST BAND (22% to 40% of the height): calm, luminous, smooth pale mist in mid-light cool slate, with slim soft out-of-focus trunks dissolving in it, low contrast, no bright spots. CEILING (top 22%): a soft, dark, low-detail canopy of out-of-focus ash-tree leaves, their pale leaves dimmed to dark grey-green shadow, no bright gaps, no landmarks. LEFT EDGE (outer 15% of the width): two huge old ash trunks with moss at the roots, their bark scratched at head height with rows of thin angular marks; at floor level between them (about 10% of the width, 62% of the height), small and low, a camp fire in a ring of stones under a leaning lean-to of branches, nobody there: it is the single warm light of the whole image, amber (#D9A441), its glow no wider than this edge zone. RIGHT EDGE (outer 17% of the width): a modest abandoned stone shelter seen side-front (its base at about 66% of the height, its roof ridge no higher than 36% from the top), low walls of weathered grey stone with moss, a broken roof of dark slate and timber with one open hole and a few bare rafters showing against the dim mist, an open dark doorway facing the clearing with two worn stone steps reaching down to the ground, nothing inside the doorway but darkness; behind it an old scratched trunk and heavy ash and pine foliage. CENTRE (from 18% to 82% of the width): open, with no trunk, no structure and no bright spot in the foreground or middle distance, so that characters can be placed there later; the middle 10% of the width is the calmest, emptiest part of the picture. STYLE: painterly dark gothic anime light-novel background painting, painted architecture, soft brush grain and paper tooth, matte surfaces, no outlines, painted edges, atmospheric depth through layered mist, large areas kept calm with detail concentrated in the two edge zones, soft brush grain only, no film grain, noise or moire, hushed, melancholic, understated. LIGHT AND PALETTE: dusk, the last cool light between the trees, cool slate ambient with a faint plum-violet tint in the far mist; no sun, no rays and no warm light except the single camp fire; a few small pale ash-leaf flakes drift near the top and the side edges. Colours: charcoal-violet shadows (#22151E, never darker than #0F0D11), under-canopy grey-green #1F2626, trunks and foliage #333C3B, cold slate #3B434D and #474A54, the pale ash earth of the clearing up to #B4B09C, a faint cold lilac (#C9B6E4) only in the mist, amber #D9A441 only at the fire; low saturation everywhere else; most of the image is dark, nothing pure black or pure white. TECHNICAL: opaque full-bleed painting filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no letterbox bars, no frame or border, no text; keep the shelter, the fire and the scratched bark marks at least 4% inside the left and right edges (the big trunks themselves may run off the edge). Do not include: people, animals, text or readable letters, UI, watermark, borders, a cross on the spire, a bell, modern objects.
